column1: In every age, there have always been those who seek to lie about the past and to rewrite history. And they lie and they lie and they lie, and frankly, they don't do a very good job. We can't let them do it. We have to stick together, and we have to fight, and we have to win. And we will win.

Before turning to the topic at hand, I want to provide a brief update on the Coronavirus, or as I call it, the China Virus. The media hasn’t been treating it fairly, and they are saying things that are just not true. We are doing a fantastic job. I think most people understand that, and you see that. We're working very hard.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the They're going to make the decision, and I hope they make the right decision. But they're going to make the decision and we'll see what happens. And we're working very hard with the different governors, and we have a lot of things that are going very well.

It is time for North Korea to realize that the denuclearization is its only acceptable future. We will watch very closely to see what happens with North Korea. We understand everything. We are watching very closely. And we are very strong. We have a very strong military, and we have a very big heart. And we want to do what's right for the world.

And then now the next slide is a nine-city roll-up. And so to save a lot of time, I won't go through all the slides in detail. But as you know, in terms of data, we've done a fantastic job. The numbers are very good, and the numbers, frankly, are all over the place.
